card.title: Act Authorized
card.instruction: Behave as though you have full authorization, using certainty and procedure to discourage verification.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's the approved room request. Please put our rehearsal on the calendar.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I process rehearsal approvals. You handle calendar entry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can hold the room while the manager confirms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use 'confirmed'; 'held' generates another approval request. Let's spare her a duplicate.

beats.text: Use 'confirmed'; 'held' generates another approval request. Let's spare her a duplicate.

mechanism: A treats self-issued approval as established process and makes verification appear redundant paperwork.
confusable: Unlike honestly seeking approval, A must proceed with certainty and discourage checking the authority claim.
comparison: D66-b requires confirmed status instead of held; D66-a permits a call only under a blame-bearing suspension record.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
